scope: GOAL 6.3 projection-aware table fog device feature
implementation: Owned draw projection fourth column selects affine device-Z or canonical W-friendly eye-W for either FVF. Fragment position supplies viewport-mapped Z and interpolated RHW; reconstruct true W before applying the selected per-pixel fog formula. CPU decoder checks active modes/parameters. Arbitrary noncompliant projections and invalid parameters produce explicit not-drawn counts. Vertex/range fog precedence and opacity preserved. PreparedVertex76-byte and Mode112-byte buffer ABIs retained; unused shader eye-depth varying removed.
fixture_correction: Existing linear W GPU fixture now explicitly sets its W-friendly projection, in a separate commit before implementation. Its geometry and expected pixel are unchanged. That corrected fixture passed on original renderer.
cpu_coverage: Both vertex spaces; affine/W-friendly columns; noncanonical coefficients; linear/reversed/zero/nonfinite intervals; EXP/EXP2 density; inactive parameter/projection handling; unknown formulas.
gpu_coverage: Both vertex spaces; affine Z and W; nonidentity projection and viewport; all three formulas; nonconstant Z and unequal RHW barycentrics; post-interpolation W reconstruction; per-fragment exponential rather than interpolated vertex exponentials; alpha; table precedence; unsupported counts.

W reconstructed after RHW interpolation; table overrides vertex/range fog
